_source: The Flight design document pp. 8-10 (the twelve founder birds: boost, unique, weakness). Multipliers on the whole colony; 1 is no change. early_trees: the trees that research faster and a day sooner (the Alchemist's).
_expansion: Doc pp. 39-40: six more founders (eighteen in all). Design calls where the doc is open: the Gannet's Plunge is +15% fishing and +10% attack, its Plunge Strike triple damage from a diving Founder; the Pelican's Pouch doubles each fish the Founder delivers; the Frigatebird's warriors steal fish like Skirmishers and its fishers ignore blockades; the Penguin's colony swims at 80% speed, its fishers never fall to sharks, and it has no Strikers or Bombers; the Owl works at night and is -20% by day; the Phoenix's starving chicks fledge at half health, its Founder is reborn once a season, and its fervour falls to nothing without a shrine.
